text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Early one morning...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Trainer! I don't often see
you at
this time of day.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The weather is so pleasant, I
thought
it would be a waste not to go
for a run.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the weather will be this
good all day.
A perfect day for training!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I have to get ready for school
now. I'll see
you later at practice!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I plan on running to my heart's content
today, so
you best prepare a suitable
plan for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when training time comes around...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing. Anyway, do you think
we could
train in the pool today?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
After all, it's important to do
cross-training,
wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Alternatively, even a lecture would
suffice.
Knowledge is also essential when
it comes to
running, is it not?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-well, I changed my mind!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course running is important. I know I
grow
stronger with every lap I run.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But, you know, having a broad
perspective can
really expand your
potential!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You might find something you never
would have
noticed while running—a
whole new version of
yourself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A true first-rate is never satisfied! They
must
always strive to become better!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! But of course!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, whether it's swimming or
studying, let's
do something other than
running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, Special Week.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I can't go partner running
with you.
We've just decided not to run
today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was wondering about that,
actually. I
thought that maybe you could
run in your school
uniform or something.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you told me this morning you
accidentally
put all of your tracksuits in
the wash at once
and—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey! There's no need to go into details!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! It's nothing! Don't mind her,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't just stand there! It's time
for us to
discover my hidden potentials!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I knew you were my trainer for a reason!
Running
is something you can do
anytime... Just not now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... I can lend you a tracksuit if you
want...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm doing this because I
don't have a
tracksuit! Cross-training is
also important, you
know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo insists on practicing other
skills today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-not at all! It's not like I put all my
tracksuits in
the washing machine by
mistake!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But fine! If you want to see me run that
badly, just
wait while I get changed!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There! Now I can run as much as you
want!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I simply feel more motivated this way!
Come on,
Special Week. It's time for
partner running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! W-wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's because of the sunny
weather or
something else, King Halo
takes off at top speed.
